facts.text: Tim expressed admiration for nature's ability to make people feel small yet connected.

evidence.quote: Wow, this is amazing! Nature is really awesome - it makes us feel tiny but connected.
Nature does have a way of humbling us and showing us our place in the world.

facts.text: John agreed with Tim's sentiment, stating that nature humbles and comforts people.

evidence.quote: Nature does have a way of humbling us and showing us our place in the world. It's truly amazing and comforting.

facts.text: Tim mentioned that nature reminds people they are part of something larger.

evidence.quote: It reminds us that we're not alone - we're part of something bigger.
